newsitem.title: GREECE: ATHENS BOURSE FREEZES DELTA SECURITIES ASSETS.
newsitem.headline: ATHENS BOURSE FREEZES DELTA SECURITIES ASSETS.

text.p: The Athens stock exchange said it was freezing the bank accounts and assets of Delta Securities, and sealing its offices and safe, after Delta was found to be in the red with the bourse clearing house for 2.6 billion drachmas.
"Shares of Delta's clients were counted and frozen, the company's offices and safe were sealed," the bourse supervisor's office said in a statement.
The supervisor's office was assisted by the financial crimes division (YPEDA) at the finance ministry, it said.
It also asked court authorities to ban Delta officials from leaving the country. Court officials had announced earlier that they were stopping senior Delta officials from leaving Greece.
Athens brokerages shut down trading at the bourse on Friday after the clearing house failed to pay several members on Thursday.
The bourse also said that its clearing house had also frozen whatever Delta assets it held. The stock exchange will continue to monitor daily brokerage trades, it said.
It was the first official statement by the bourse since the settlement row erupted on Thursday.
